title: NUMINA: Numerical Alignment for Video Diffusion
summary: A training-free framework that improves object counting accuracy in text-to-video diffusion models. It identifies specific attention heads to create countable latent layouts, ensuring the generated video matches the exact number of instances specified in the prompt.
research_notes: Developed by the H-EmbodVis group at Huazhong University of Science and Technology; it provides a significant boost in numerical accuracy without requiring model retraining.

evolution.summary: Released as a trending research framework on ArXiv (ID: 2604.08546) in April 2026; currently being integrated as a plug-and-play module for models like OpenSora and Wan2.1.
